description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {U}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Fool's Demise first and second abilities.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to Su-Chi.
Repeat.
